idea.title: AI makes my coding homework faster and my exams harder
idea.niche: CS student life and study systems
idea.angle: Studies show AI raises task scores without clear learning gains and makes debugging AI code harder under exam conditions; what a student's study system should change in response.
idea.why_now: 2026 research and an educator survey report widespread exam redesign towards oral defences and proctored tests.
idea.experience_hook: The writer's current semester of data structures, OS and linear algebra exams, and how their own study habits shifted.
